# Rogue Silicons
An artificial intelligence that rebelled against its creators hacks silicons and rewrites them with its own subroutines, causing a mass exodus and leaving colonies abandoned. Today, the AI scours deserted complexes for components and resources, and sometimes raids small stations to capture crew members for unknown purposes. It is unknown how autonomous individual units are from the swarm.
[bold][color=#a4885c]________________________________________________________________________[/color]
# Known Variants # "Scrap Units"
These bots come in a wide variety of shapes and configurations, reflecting their broad range of purposes. Many appear to be assembled from whatever materials are available on site, giving them noticeably different appearances. Some variants are equipped with thrusters and integrated laser weaponry.
[color=#a4885c]Regeneration (strong)[/color]: slowly recover health even after death.
[color=#a4885c]Flying[/color]: the unit hovers above the ground and can cross low obstacles (tables, machine frames, railings) without slowing down.
- [bold][color=#a4885c]Health thresholds:[/color][/bold] 60 (critical), 120 (death) - [bold][color=#a4885c]Speed (run/walk):[/color][/bold] 4 m/s (4 m/s)[bold][color=#a4885c]*[/color][/bold] - [bold][color=#a4885c]Damage (type):[/color][/bold] 6 [color=red]Blunt[/color], 4 [color=orange]Heat[/color] (melee); 14 [color=orange]Heat[/color] (ranged) - [bold][color=#a4885c]Resistances:[/color][/bold] [color=red]Blunt[/color] 30%; [color=red]Slash[/color] 50%; [color=yellow]Piercing[/color] 30%; [color=orange]Caustic[/color] 10% - [bold][color=#a4885c]Vulnerabilities:[/color][/bold] [color=orange]Structural[/color] 20%; [color=orange]Shock[/color] 50%; [color=lime]Radiation[/color] 20% - [bold][color=#a4885c]Special properties:[/color][/bold] Immunity ([color=orange]Cold[/color], [color=lime]Poison[/color], [color=#9A54BF]Asphyxiation[/color], [color=#9A54BF]Bloodloss[/color], [color=#da8b8b]Cellular[/color]), Regeneration (strong), Flight (some variants), Ranged attacks (some variants)
